text: Preserve a credible run record for the first autonomous external-value delivery
description: For the first real external-value experiment, preserve one reproducible discover→plan→execute→verify→present run that a stranger can inspect. Capture the selected aim, planning transitions, tool actions, verification, failures/recovery, resulting deliverable, and the external beneficiary's acceptance/use/merge/payment or explicit rejection. A screen recording is useful but optional if a structured run log and repository history are sufficient. This is no longer a BuilderShip deadline artifact; it supports the canonical external-value proof.

status.comment: The strict schema, valid template, and recording guidance are ready. Completing the aim requires a real externally authorized run and evidence of beneficiary acceptance, use, merge, payment, or rejection.

reflection: Prepared meta/external-value-run-record.schema.json, .template.json, and .md. The record captures mission path, hypothesis, authority, transitions, actions, verification, delivery, external outcome, failures/recovery, full economics, and belief update. Non-pending external outcomes require dated external evidence, and unknown fields are rejected. Verification: JSON parses; AJV 2020 strict compilation succeeds; the template validates; negative cases reject an accepted outcome without evidence and an extra untracked property; git diff --check passes.
